carries.control: The option removed: running the finder's D3 harness as committed. tools/audit/round8/D3/s1_claimkill.py line 54 sets TMP = /home/claude/audit-r8/tmp/D3-s1 and passes it as TMPDIR, and tools/audit/round8/D3/s1_cachekey.py's plandata arm sets HPO_PLANDATA=/home/claude/audit-r8/tmp/D3-s1/plandata; tools/audit/round8/D3/v1_suite_mutants.py line 33 sets /home/claude/audit-r8/tmp/D3-v1. Those roots existed only in the cloud audit container. On the Mac, mkdir /home/claude is refused (Operation not supported), measured by PR #1551's fix reviewer. The judge ran sed-rewritten copies with the root moved and reproduced the finder's numbers, so the root is incidental to the measurement: the null control is the same harness with only that constant changed.
carries.remeasure: Before trusting any number, point the root at a directory under your own TMPDIR (a sed of the one constant, or an env override), run the harness at your merge base and at your head, and diff the only-root-changed copy against the transport copy to show nothing else moved. Cite the transport path with its sha1 as fixer.md step 3 asks, and disclose the root edit as yours.
carries.brief: Precondition for using these harnesses: derive the temp root from TMPDIR, never the hard-coded /home/claude path. Harnesses are not in the tree: restore them from transport commit 6f58e33e as the round-8 register section 'What this commit does not carry' in docs/audit-2026-09.md says, so every tools/audit/round8/D3/... path below resolves.

carries.control: Several finder perturbations edit production or test files on disk in the working tree, the D3 s2 harnesses among them (the judge's note 3). The harnesses this stage runs rewrite a production file in place and restore it afterwards: tools/audit/round8/D3/s2_finding01_hours_since.py (open(LEG, "w") at lines 108 and 142), tools/audit/round8/D3/s2_finding02_deadband_boundary.py (open(SVC_PATH, "w") at lines 142 and 146), tools/audit/round8/D3/v1_legionella_due.py (LEG.write_text at lines 91 and 96) and tools/audit/round8/D3/v1_suite_mutants.py (the mutant write and restore at lines 98-108). A concurrent run in the same tree then imports the edited file. The judge measured it: its first D2-s1-01 run overlapped its own D0 ftol edit, and that run was discarded; a clean re-run in an idle tree gave identical numbers, which is the null control separating the contamination from the result.
carries.remeasure: Run each on-disk harness in a worktree that nothing else runs in (not the shared checkout, not a tree another seat's gate is using), or hold the gate lease for the duration with python3 tests/gate_lock.py take --label <seat>. After each run, git status must show the tree clean before you measure anything else there.
carries.brief: Narrowed: an on-disk harness is legitimate only in an otherwise idle tree or under the gate lease, whatever fixer.md says about the lease being for MODE FULL and stress.py only. Prefer in-memory perturbation if your fix touches the harness. Harnesses are not in the tree: restore them from transport commit 6f58e33e as the round-8 register section 'What this commit does not carry' in docs/audit-2026-09.md says, so every tools/audit/round8/D3/... path below resolves.
